acceptanceCriteria: The lint fails on raise InterruptedError inside a signal handler
It runs in the doc/static gates
body: Follow-up from the spike lane (2026-10-21, branch claude/batch-spike; the evidence is in docs/build-log/2026-10-21-*.md once that batch lands). V1-0610 was not reproduced: all 4 scripts raise SystemExit or KeyboardInterrupt and kill their process groups. A lint keeps it that way.
title: Lint Python signal handlers for raise InterruptedError
